F16.before:
Upon concluding the prayer, say the following supplication:
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ
ALLAAHUMMA INNEE ATAQARRABU ILAYKA BIJOODIKA WA KARAMIK
O Allah, I seek nearness to You in the name of Your magnanimity and nobility.
وَاَتَقرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
WA ATAQARRABU ILAYKA BIMUHAMMADIN A'BDIKA WA RASOOLIK
I seek nearness to You in the name of Muhammad, Your servant and messenger.
وَاَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِمَلاَئِكَتِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبينَ
WA ATAQARRABU ILAYKA BIMALAA'IKATIKAL MUQARRABEEN
I seek nearness to You in the name of Your Favorite Angels
وَاَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ
WA ANBIYAA'IKA WA RUSULIK
and Your prophets and messengers,
اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ
AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN
[and I beseech You] to send blessings to Muhammad,
عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
A'BDIKA WA RASOOLIK
Your servant and messenger,
وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
WA A'LAA AALI MUHAMMAD
and upon the Household of Muhammad,
وَاَنْ تُقِيلَنِي عَثْرَتِي
WA AN TUQEELANEE A'THRATEE
overlook my slips,
وَتَسْتُرَ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوبِي
WA TASTURA A'LAYYA DHUNOOBEE
cover my sins,
وَتَغْفِرَهَا لِي
WA TAGHFIRAHAA LEE
forgive them for me,
وَتَقْضِيَ لِي حَوَائِجِي
WA TAQDIYA LEE HAWAA'IJEE
settle all my needs,
وَلاَ تُعَذِّبْنِي بِقَبِيحٍ كَانَ مِنِّي
WA LAA TU'ADHDHIBNEE BIQABEEHIN KAANA MINNEE
and not to punish me for the evildoings that I have committed.
فَإنَّ عَفْوَكَ وَجُودَكَ يَسَعُنِي
FA-INNA A'FWAKA WA JOODAKA YASA'UNEE
Verily, Your pardon and magnanimity include me.
إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَديرٌ
INNAKA A'LAA KULLI SHAY'IN QADEER
Verily, You have power over all things.

F17.before:
Upon concluding the prayer, say the following supplication:
اَللَّهُمَّ اَنْتَ الَّذِي ٱسْتَجَبْتَ لِاٰدَمَ وَحَوَّاءَ إِذْ قَالاَ
ALLAAHUMMA ANTAL LADHEES TAJABTA LI-AADAMA WA HAWWAA'A IDH QAALAA
O Allah, it is You who responded to Adam and Eve when they both said,
رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا اَنْفُسَنَا
RABBANAA ZALAMNAA ANFUSANAA
“Our Lord! We have been unjust to ourselves,
وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا
WA IN LAM TAGHFIR LANAA WA TARHAMNAA
and if You forgive us not and have not mercy on us,
لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَاسِرِينَ
LANAKOONANNA MINAL KHAASIREEN
we shall certainly be of the losers.”
وَنَادَاكَ نُوحٌ فَٱسْتَجَبْتَ لَهُ
WA NAADAAKA NOOHUN FASTAJABTA LAHOO
And when Noah cried to You, You answered him
وَنَجَّيْتَهُ وَاَهْلَهُ مِنَ ٱلكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
WA NAJJAYTAHOO WA AHLAHOO MINAL KARBIL A'ZEEM
and delivered him and his family from the great calamity.
وَاَطْفَاْتَ نَارَ نُمْرُودَ عَنْ خَلِيلِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
WA ATFA'TA NAARA NUMROODA A'N KHALEELIKA IBRAAHEEM
And it is You who extinguished the fire of Nimrod for Your intimate friend Abraham
فَجَعَلْتَهَا بَرْداً وَسَلاماً
FAJA'ALTAHAA BARDAN WA SALAAMAA
and thus changed it into coldness and peace.
وَاَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي ٱسْتَجَبْتَ لاَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ
WA ANTAL LADHEES TAJABTA LI-AYYOOBA IDH NAADAA
And it is You Who responded to Job when he cried to You, saying,
إِنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَاَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّاحِمِينَ
INNEE MASSANIYAD DURRU WA ANTA ARHAMUR RAAHIMEEN
“Harm has afflicted me, and You are the most Merciful of all those who show mercy.”
فَكَشَفْتَ مَا بِهِ مِنْ ضُرٍّ
FAKASHAFTA MAA BIHEE MIN DURR
Therefore, You took off what harm he had,
وَآتَيْتَهُ اَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ
WA AATAYTAHOO AHLAHOO WA MITHLAHUM MA'AHUM
and You gave him his family and the like of them with them:
رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِاُولِي ٱلاَلْبَابِ
RAHMATAN MIN I'NDIKA WA DHIKRAA LI-ULIL ALBAAB
a mercy from You and a reminder to the owners of sound intellects.
وَاَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي ٱسْتَجَبْتَ لِذِي ٱلنُّونِ
WA ANTAL LADHEES TAJABTA LIDHIN NOON
And it is You Who responded to Dhu'l-Nun (i.e. Prophet Jonah)
حِينَ نَادَاكَ فِي ٱلظّلُمَاتِ
HEENA NAADAAKA FIZ ZULUMAAT
when he cried through the depths of darkness,
اَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ اَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ
AN LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA SUBHAANAKA
“There is no god but You. Glory be to You.
إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
INNEE KUNTU MINAZ ZAALIMEEN
I was indeed of those who are wrong!”
فَنَجَّيْتَهُ مِنَ ٱلغَمِّ
FANAJJAYTAHOO MINAL GHAMM
So, You delivered him from distress.
وَاَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي ٱسْتَجَبْتَ لِمُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ دَعْوَتَهُمَا
WA ANTAL LADHEES TAJABTA LIMOOSAA WA HAAROONA DA'WATAHUMAA
And it is You Who responded to the prayer of Moses and Aaron
حِينَ قُلْتَ قَدْ اُجِيبَتْ دَعْوَتُكُمَا فَٱسْتَقِيمَا
HEENA QULTA QAD UJEEBAT DA'WATUKUMAA FASTAQEEMAA
when You said, “Accepted is your prayer! So, stand you straight.”
وَاَغْرَقْتَ فِرعَوْنَ وَقَوْمَهُ
WA AGHRAQTA FIR'AWNA WA QAWMAH
You thus drowned Pharaoh and his people.
وَغَفَرْتَ لِدَاوُودَ ذَنْبَهُ
WA GHAFARTA LIDAAWOODA DHANBAH
You forgave the sin of David
وَتُبْتَ عَلَيْهِ رَحْمَةً مِنْكَ وَذِكْرَىٰ
WA TUBTA A'LAYHI RAHMATAN MINKA WA DHIKRAA
and accepted his repentance out of Your mercy and as a reminder.
وَفَدَيْتَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
WA FADAYTA ISMAA'EELA BIDHIBHIN A'ZEEM
You ransomed Ishmael with a momentous sacrifice
بَعْدَ مَا اَسْلَمَ وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ
BA'DA MAA ASLAMA WA TALLAHOO LIL JABEEN
after he had submitted his will and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead for sacrifice.
فَنَادَيْتَهُ بِٱلْفَرَجِ وَٱلرَّوْحِ
FANAADAYTAHOO BIL FARAJI WAR RAWH
Hence, You called him with relief and comfort.
وَاَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي نَادَاكَ زَكَرِيَّا نِدَاءً خَفِيّاً
WA ANTAL LADHEE NAADAAKA ZAKARIYYAA NIDAA'AN KHAFIYYAA
And it is You to Whom Zachariah cried in secret,
فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّي
FAQAALA RABBI INNEE WAHANAL A'ZMU MINNEE
praying, “O my Lord! Infirm indeed are my bones,
وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّاْسُ شَيْباً
WASH TA'ALAR RA'SU SHAYBAA
and the hair of my head has glistened with grey,
وَلَمْ اَكُنْ بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيّاً
WA LAM AKUN BIDU'AA'IKA RABBI SHAQIYYAA
but never am I unblest, O my Lord, in my prayer to You.”
وَقُلْتَ يَدْعُونَنَا رَغَباً وَرَهَباً
WA QULTA YAD'OONANAA RAGHABAN WA RAHABAA
And You said, “They used to call on Us with love and reverence
وَكَانُوا لَنَا خَاشِعِينَ
WA KAANOO LANAA KHAASHI'EEN
and they humbled themselves before Us.”
وَاَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي ٱسْتَجَبْتَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوٱ ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ
WA ANTAL LADHEES TAJABTA LILLADHEENA AAMANOO WA A'MILUS SAALIHAAT
And it is You Who responded to those who had believed and done good deeds
لِتَزِيدَهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
LITAZEEDAHUM MIN FADLIK
so as to increase Your favor upon them.
فَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي مِنْ اَهْوَنِ ٱلدَّاعِينَ لَكَ وَٱلرَّاغِبِينَ إِلَيْكَ
FALAA TAJ'ALNEE MIN AHWANID DAA'EENA LAKA WAR RAAGHIBEENA ILAYK
So, (please) do not consider me the most debased suppliant and desirous to You.
وَٱسْتَجِبْ لِي كَمَا ٱسْتَجَبْتَ لَهُمْ
WASTAJIB LEE KAMAS TAJABTA LAHUM
And respond to me in the same way as You responded to them,
بِحَقِّهِمْ عَلَيْكَ
BIHAQQIHIM A'LAYK
(I beseech to You) by their right (that is incumbent) on You.
فَطَهِّرْنِي بِتَطْهِيـرِكَ
FATAHHIRNEE BITATHEERIK
Purify me with Your purification,
وَتَقَبَّلْ صَلاَتِي وَدُعَائِي بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ
WA TAQABBAL SALAATEE WA DU'AA'EE BIQABOOLIN HASAN
accept my prayer and supplication in the best manner,
وَطَيِّبْ بَقِيَّةَ حَيَاتِي
WA TAYYIB BAQIYYATA HAYAATEE
make the rest of my life good,
وَطَيِّبْ وَفَاتِي
WA TAYYIB WAFAATEE
make my demise good,
وَٱخْلُفْنِي فِيمَنْ اَخْلُفُ
WAKHLUFNEE FEEMAN AKHLUF
be the supervisor of my inheritors,
وَٱحْفَظْنِي يَا رَبِّ بِدُعَائِي
WAHFAZNEE YAA RABBI BIDU'AA'EE
safeguard me, O my Lord, through my supplication,
وَٱجْعَلْ ذُرِّيَّتِي ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً
WAJ'AL DHURRIYYATEE DHURRIYYATAN TAYYIBAH
and make my offspring goodly
تَحُوطُهَا بِحِيَاطَتِكَ
TAHOOTUHAA BIHIYAATATIK
by encompassing them
بِكُلِّ مَا حُطْتَ بِهِ ذُرِّيَّةَ اَحَدٍ مِنْ اَوْلِيَائِكَ وَاَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ
BIKULLI MAA HUTTA BIHEE DHURRIYYATA AHADIN MIN AWLIYAA'IKA WA AHLI TAA'ATIK
with the same things with which You have encompassed the offspring of Your intimate saints and the people who obeyed You appropriately,
بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ ٱلرَّاحِمِينَ
BIRAHMATIKA YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEEN
out of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
يَا مَنْ هُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ رَقِيبٌ
YAA MAN HUWA A'LAA KULLI SHAY'IN RAQEEB
O You Who observes all things,
وَلِكُلِّ دَاعٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ مُجِيبٌ
WA LIKULLI DAA'IN MIN KHALQIKA MUJEEB
Who answers all those who supplicate to You amongst Your creatures,
وَمِنْ كُلِّ سَائِلٍ قَرِيبٌ
WA MIN KULLI SAA'ILIN QAREEB
and Who is close to all those who implore You!
اَسْاَلُكَ يَا لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ اَنْتَ
AS'ALUKA YAA LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANT
I thus implore You, O He save Whom there is no god,
ٱلْحَيُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ
AL-HAYYUL QAYYOOM
O He Who is Ever-living, Self-Subsisting,
ٱلاَحَدُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
AL-AHADUS SAMAD
One and Only, Absolute,
ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
ALLADHEE LAM YALID WA LAM YOOLAD
You beget not nor are You begotten
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً اَحَدٌ
WA LAM YAKUN LAHOO KUFUWAN AHAD
and there is none like unto You.
وَبِكُلِّ ٱسْمٍ رَفَعْتَ بِهِ سَمَاءَكَ
WA BIKULLIS MIN RAFA'TA BIHEE SAMAA'AK
And I implore You by all Names with which You raised Your heavens,
وَفَرَشْتَ بِهِ اَرْضَكَ
WA FARASHTA BIHEE ARDAK
spread out Your earth,
وَاَرْسَيْتَ بِهِ ٱلْجِبَالَ
WA ARSAYTA BIHIL JIBAAL
firmly fixed the mountains,
وَاَجْرَيْتَ بِهِ ٱلْمَاءَ
WA AJRAYTA BIHIL MAA'
made water flow,
وَسَخَّرْتَ بِهِ ٱلسَّحَابَ
WA SAKHKHARTA BIHIS SAHAAB
made the clouds subservient,
وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ
WASH SHAMSA WAL QAMARA WAN NUJOOM
as well as the sun, the moon, the stars,
وَٱللَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ
WAL LAYLA WAN NAHAAR
the night, and the daylight,
وَخَلَقْتَ ٱلْخَلائِقَ كُلَّهَا
WA KHALAQTAL KHALAA'IQA KULLAHAA
and created all beings.
اَسْاَلُكَ بِعَظَمَةِ وَجْهِكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
AS'ALUKA BI-A'ZAMATI WAJHIKAL A'ZEEM
I implore You by the magnitude of Your Magnificent Face
ٱلَّذِي اَشْرَقَتْ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ وَٱلاَرْضُ
ALLADHEE ASHRAQAT LAHUS SAMAAWAATU WAL ARD
to which the heavens and the earth shone
فَاَضَاءَتْ بِهِ ٱلظُّلُمَاتُ
FA-ADAA'AT BIHIZ ZULUMAAT
causing darkness to change into lights,
إِلاَّ صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
ILLAA SALLAYTA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD
(I implore You by all these) to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
وَكَفَيْتَنِي اَمْرَ مَعَاشِي وَمَعَادِي
WA KAFAYTANEE AMRA MA'AASHEE WA MA'AADEE
save me from the troubles of my living and my other life,
وَاَصْلَحْتَ لِي شَاْنِي كُلَّهُ
WA ASLAHTA LEE SHA'NEE KULLAH
amend all my affairs,
وَلَمْ تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
WA LAM TAKILNEE ILAA NAFSEE TARFATA A'YN
not to cause me to depend upon myself for even a winking of an eye,
وَاَصْلَحْتَ اَمْرِي وَاَمْرَ عِيَالِي
WA ASLAHTA AMREE WA AMRA I'YAALEE
manage the affairs of my household and me,
وَكَفَيْتَنِي هَمَّهُمْ
WA KAFAYTANEE HAMMAHUM
save me from their concerns,
وَاَغْنَيْتَنِي وَإِيَّاهُمْ مِنْ كَنْزِكَ وَخَزَائِنِكَ
WA AGHNAYTANEE WA IYYAAHUM MIN KANZIKA WA KHAZAA'INIK
make them and me rich out of Your treasure, hoards,
وَسَعَةِ فَضْلِكَ الَّذِي لاَ يَنْفَدُ اَبَداً
WA SA'ATI FADLIKAL LADHEE LAA YANFADU ABADAA
and Your expansive grace that never runs out,
وَاَثْبِتْ فِي قَلْبِي يَنَابِيعَ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ
WA ATHBIT FEE QALBEE YANAABEE'AL HIKMAH
fix in my heart founts of sagacity
ٱلَّتِي تَنْفَعُنِي بِهَا
ALLATEE TANFA'UNEE BIHAA
from which I may benefit
وَتَنْفَعُ بِهَا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَيْتَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
WA TANFA'U BIHAA MANIR TADAYTA MIN I'BAADIK
and from which You may benefit Your servants with whom You are pleased,
وَٱجْعَلْ لِي مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
WAJ'AL LEE MINAL MUTTAQEEN
choose for me an imam (i.e. leader)
فِي آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ إِمَاماً
FEE AAKHIRIZ ZAMAANI IMAAMAA
that is pious in the last of time
كَمَا جَعَلْتَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ٱلْخَلِيلَ إِمَاماً
KAMAA JA'ALTA IBRAAHEEMAL KHALEELA IMAAMAA
in the same way as You made Abraham Your intimate friend to be a leader.
فَإِنَّ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ يَفُوزُ ٱلْفَائِزُونَ
FA-INNA BITAWFEEQIKA YAFOOZUL FAA'IZOON
Verily, only through Your guidance do the winners achieve prosperity,
وَيَتُوبُ ٱلتَّائِبُونَ
WA YATOOBUT TAA'IBOON
the repentant declare repentance,
وَيَعْبُدُكَ ٱلْعَابِدُونَ
WA YA'BUDUKAL A'ABIDOON
and the true worshippers worship You.
وَبِتَسْدِيدِكَ يَصْلُحُ ٱلصَّالِحُونَ
WA BITASDEEDIKA YASLUHUS SAALIHOON
And only through Your supervision do the righteous,
ٱلْمُحْسِنُونَ ٱلْمُخْبِتُونَ
AL-MUHSINOONAL MUKHBITOON
the good-doers, those who humble themselves before You,
ٱلْعَابِدُونَ لَكَ ٱلْخَائِفُونَ مِنْكَ
AL-A'ABIDOONA LAKAL KHAA'IFOONA MINK
those who worship You sincerely, and those who fear You become righteous.
وَبِإِرْشَادِكَ نَجَا ٱلنَّاجُونَ مِنْ نَارِكَ
WA BI-IRSHAADIKA NAJAN NAAJOONA MIN NAARIK
And only through Your direction will those who will be delivered from Your Hellfire be saved
وَاَشْفَقَ مِنْهَا ٱلْمُشْفِقُونَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
WA ASHFAQA MINHAL MUSHFIQOONA MIN KHALQIK
and those who fear You, from amongst Your creatures, stand in awe of it.
وَبِخِذْلاَنِكَ خَسِرَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
WA BIKHIDHLAANIKA KHASIRAL MUBTILOON
But through Your disappointing them will the wrong lose,
وَهَلَكَ ٱلظَّالِمُونَ
WA HALAKAZ ZAALIMOON
the unjust perish,
وَغَفَلَ ٱلْغَافِلُونَ
WA GHAFALAL GHAAFILOON
and those distracted from You be inattentive.
اَللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا
ALLAAHUMMA AATI NAFSEE TAQWAAHAA
O Allah, grant my soul its piety
فَاَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلاَهَا
FA-ANTA WALIYYUHAA WA MAWLAAHAA
for You are its guardian and master
وَاَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا
WA ANTA KHAYRU MAN ZAKKAAHAA
and You are the best to purify it.
اَللَّهُمَّ بَيِّنْ لَهَا هُدَاهَا
ALLAAHUMMA BAYYIN LAHAA HUDAAHAA
O Allah, show it its true guidance,
وَاَلْهِمْهَا تَقْوَاهَا
WA ALHIMHAA TAQWAAHAA
inspire it with what is good for it,
وَبَشِّرْهَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ حِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهَا
WA BASHSHIRHAA BIRAHMATIKA HEENA TATAWAFFAAHAA
carry to it the good news of Your mercy when You grasp it,
وَنَزِّلْهَا مِنَ ٱلْجِنَانِ عُلْيَاهَا
WA NAZZILHAA MINAL JINAANI U'LYAAHAA
lodge it in the highest positions of the gardens of Paradise,
وَطَيِّبْ وَفَاتَهَا وَمَحْيَاهَا
WA TAYYIB WAFAATAHAA WA MAHYAAHAA
make good its death and life,
وَاَكْرِمْ مُنْقَلَبَهَا وَمَثْوَاهَا
WA AKRIM MUNQALABAHAA WA MATHWAAHAA
and honor its place and abode
وَمُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمَاْوَاهَا
WA MUSTAQARRAHAA WA MA'WAAHAA
and its dwelling and house,
فَاَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلاَهَا
FA-ANTA WALIYYUHAA WA MAWLAAHAA
for You are its guardian and master.
F17.after:
Upon concluding the prayer, say the following supplication:
اَللَّهُمَّ اَنْتَ الَّذِي اسْتَجَبْتَ لِاٰدَمَ وَحَوَّاءَ اِذْ قَالَا
ALLAAHUMMA ANTAL LADHEES TAJABTA LI-AADAMA WA HAWWAA'A IDH QAALAA
O Allah, it is You who responded to Adam and Eve when they both said,
رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا اَنْفُسَنَا
RABBANAA ZALAMNAA ANFUSANAA
“Our Lord! We have been unjust to ourselves,
وَاِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا
WA IN LAM TAGHFIR LANAA WA TARHAMNAA
and if You forgive us not and have not mercy on us,
لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
LANAKOONANNA MINAL KHAASIREEN
we shall certainly be of the losers.”
وَنَادَاكَ نُوحٌ فَاسْتَجَبْتَ لَهُ
WA NAADAAKA NOOHUN FASTAJABTA LAHOO
And when Noah cried to You, You answered him
وَنَجَّيْتَهُ وَاَهْلَهُ مِنَ الكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ
WA NAJJAYTAHOO WA AHLAHOO MINAL KARBIL A'ZEEM
and delivered him and his family from the great calamity.
وَاَطْفَاْتَ نَارَ نُمْرُودَ عَنْ خَلِيلِكَ اِبْرَاهِيمَ
WA ATFA'TA NAARA NUMROODA A'N KHALEELIKA IBRAAHEEM
And it is You who extinguished the fire of Nimrod for Your intimate friend Abraham
فَجَعَلْتَهَا بَرْداً وَسَلاماً
FAJA'ALTAHAA BARDAN WA SALAAMAA
and thus changed it into coldness and peace.
وَاَنْتَ الَّذِي اسْتَجَبْتَ لَايُّوبَ اِذْ نَادَىٰ
WA ANTAL LADHEES TAJABTA LI-AYYOOBA IDH NAADAA
And it is You Who responded to Job when he cried to You, saying,
اِنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَاَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
INNEE MASSANIYAD DURRU WA ANTA ARHAMUR RAAHIMEEN
“Harm has afflicted me, and You are the most Merciful of all those who show mercy.”
فَكَشَفْتَ مَا بِهِ مِنْ ضُرٍّ
FAKASHAFTA MAA BIHEE MIN DURR
Therefore, You took off what harm he had,
وَآتَيْتَهُ اَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ
WA AATAYTAHOO AHLAHOO WA MITHLAHUM MA'AHUM
and You gave him his family and the like of them with them:
رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِاُولِي الَالْبَابِ
RAHMATAN MIN I'NDIKA WA DHIKRAA LI-ULIL ALBAAB
a mercy from You and a reminder to the owners of sound intellects.
وَاَنْتَ الَّذِي اسْتَجَبْتَ لِذِي النُّونِ
WA ANTAL LADHEES TAJABTA LIDHIN NOON
And it is You Who responded to Dhu'l-Nun (i.e. Prophet Jonah)
حِينَ نَادَاكَ فِي الظّلُمَاتِ
HEENA NAADAAKA FIZ ZULUMAAT
when he cried through the depths of darkness,
اَنْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ
AN LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA SUBHAANAKA
“There is no god but You. Glory be to You.
اِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
INNEE KUNTU MINAZ ZAALIMEEN
I was indeed of those who are wrong!”
فَنَجَّيْتَهُ مِنَ الغَمِّ
FANAJJAYTAHOO MINAL GHAMM
So, You delivered him from distress.
وَاَنْتَ الَّذِي اسْتَجَبْتَ لِمُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ دَعْوَتَهُمَا
WA ANTAL LADHEES TAJABTA LIMOOSAA WA HAAROONA DA'WATAHUMAA
And it is You Who responded to the prayer of Moses and Aaron
حِينَ قُلْتَ قَدْ اُجِيبَتْ دَعْوَتُكُمَا فَاسْتَقِيمَا
HEENA QULTA QAD UJEEBAT DA'WATUKUMAA FASTAQEEMAA
when You said, “Accepted is your prayer! So, stand you straight.”
وَاَغْرَقْتَ فِرعَوْنَ وَقَوْمَهُ
WA AGHRAQTA FIR'AWNA WA QAWMAH
You thus drowned Pharaoh and his people.
وَغَفَرْتَ لِدَاوُودَ ذَنْبَهُ
WA GHAFARTA LIDAAWOODA DHANBAH
You forgave the sin of David
وَتُبْتَ عَلَيْهِ رَحْمَةً مِنْكَ وَذِكْرَىٰ
WA TUBTA A'LAYHI RAHMATAN MINKA WA DHIKRAA
and accepted his repentance out of Your mercy and as a reminder.
وَفَدَيْتَ اِسْمَاعِيلَ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
WA FADAYTA ISMAA'EELA BIDHIBHIN A'ZEEM
You ransomed Ishmael with a momentous sacrifice
بَعْدَ مَا اَسْلَمَ وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ
BA'DA MAA ASLAMA WA TALLAHOO LIL JABEEN
after he had submitted his will and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead for sacrifice.
فَنَادَيْتَهُ بِالْفَرَجِ وَالرَّوْحِ
FANAADAYTAHOO BIL FARAJI WAR RAWH
Hence, You called him with relief and comfort.
وَاَنْتَ الَّذِي نَادَاكَ زَكَرِيَّا نِدَاءً خَفِيّاً
WA ANTAL LADHEE NAADAAKA ZAKARIYYAA NIDAA'AN KHAFIYYAA
And it is You to Whom Zachariah cried in secret,
فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّي وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي
FAQAALA RABBI INNEE WAHANAL A'ZMU MINNEE
praying, “O my Lord! Infirm indeed are my bones,
وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّاْسُ شَيْباً
WASH TA'ALAR RA'SU SHAYBAA
and the hair of my head has glistened with grey,
وَلَمْ اَكُنْ بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيّاً
WA LAM AKUN BIDU'AA'IKA RABBI SHAQIYYAA
but never am I unblest, O my Lord, in my prayer to You.”
وَقُلْتَ يَدْعُونَنَا رَغَباً وَرَهَباً
WA QULTA YAD'OONANAA RAGHABAN WA RAHABAA
And You said, “They used to call on Us with love and reverence
وَكَانُوا لَنَا خَاشِعِينَ
WA KAANOO LANAA KHAASHI'EEN
and they humbled themselves before Us.”
وَاَنْتَ الَّذِي اسْتَجَبْتَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ
WA ANTAL LADHEES TAJABTA LILLADHEENA AAMANOO WA A'MILUS SAALIHAAT
And it is You Who responded to those who had believed and done good deeds
لِتَزِيدَهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
LITAZEEDAHUM MIN FADLIK
so as to increase Your favor upon them.
فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي مِنْ اَهْوَنِ الدَّاعِينَ لَكَ وَالرَّاغِبِينَ اِلَيْكَ
FALAA TAJ'ALNEE MIN AHWANID DAA'EENA LAKA WAR RAAGHIBEENA ILAYK
So, (please) do not consider me the most debased suppliant and desirous to You.
وَاسْتَجِبْ لِي كَمَا اسْتَجَبْتَ لَهُمْ
WASTAJIB LEE KAMAS TAJABTA LAHUM
And respond to me in the same way as You responded to them,
بِحَقِّهِمْ عَلَيْكَ
BIHAQQIHIM A'LAYK
(I beseech to You) by their right (that is incumbent) on You.
فَطَهِّرْنِي بِتَطْهِيـرِكَ
FATAHHIRNEE BITATHEERIK
Purify me with Your purification,
وَتَقَبَّلْ صَلَاتِي وَدُعَائِي بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ
WA TAQABBAL SALAATEE WA DU'AA'EE BIQABOOLIN HASAN
accept my prayer and supplication in the best manner,
وَطَيِّبْ بَقِيَّةَ حَيَاتِي
WA TAYYIB BAQIYYATA HAYAATEE
make the rest of my life good,
وَطَيِّبْ وَفَاتِي
WA TAYYIB WAFAATEE
make my demise good,
وَاخْلُفْنِي فِيمَنْ اَخْلُفُ
WAKHLUFNEE FEEMAN AKHLUF
be the supervisor of my inheritors,
وَاحْفَظْنِي يَا رَبِّ بِدُعَائِي
WAHFAZNEE YAA RABBI BIDU'AA'EE
safeguard me, O my Lord, through my supplication,
وَاجْعَلْ ذُرِّيَّتِي ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً
WAJ'AL DHURRIYYATEE DHURRIYYATAN TAYYIBAH
and make my offspring goodly
تَحُوطُهَا بِحِيَاطَتِكَ
TAHOOTUHAA BIHIYAATATIK
by encompassing them
بِكُلِّ مَا حُطْتَ بِهِ ذُرِّيَّةَ اَحَدٍ مِنْ اَوْلِيَائِكَ وَاَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ
BIKULLI MAA HUTTA BIHEE DHURRIYYATA AHADIN MIN AWLIYAA'IKA WA AHLI TAA'ATIK
with the same things with which You have encompassed the offspring of Your intimate saints and the people who obeyed You appropriately,
بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
BIRAHMATIKA YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEEN
out of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
يَا مَنْ هُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ رَقِيبٌ
YAA MAN HUWA A'LAA KULLI SHAY'IN RAQEEB
O You Who observes all things,
وَلِكُلِّ دَاعٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ مُجِيبٌ
WA LIKULLI DAA'IN MIN KHALQIKA MUJEEB
Who answers all those who supplicate to You amongst Your creatures,
وَمِنْ كُلِّ سَائِلٍ قَرِيبٌ
WA MIN KULLI SAA'ILIN QAREEB
and Who is close to all those who implore You!
اَسْاَلُكَ يَا لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
AS'ALUKA YAA LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANT
I thus implore You, O He save Whom there is no god,
الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
AL-HAYYUL QAYYOOM
O He Who is Ever-living, Self-Subsisting,
الَاحَدُ الصَّمَدُ
AL-AHADUS SAMAD
One and Only, Absolute,
الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
ALLADHEE LAM YALID WA LAM YOOLAD
You beget not nor are You begotten
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً اَحَدٌ
WA LAM YAKUN LAHOO KUFUWAN AHAD
and there is none like unto You.
وَبِكُلِّ اسْمٍ رَفَعْتَ بِهِ سَمَاءَكَ
WA BIKULLIS MIN RAFA'TA BIHEE SAMAA'AK
And I implore You by all Names with which You raised Your heavens,
وَفَرَشْتَ بِهِ اَرْضَكَ
WA FARASHTA BIHEE ARDAK
spread out Your earth,
وَاَرْسَيْتَ بِهِ الْجِبَالَ
WA ARSAYTA BIHIL JIBAAL
firmly fixed the mountains,
وَاَجْرَيْتَ بِهِ الْمَاءَ
WA AJRAYTA BIHIL MAA'
made water flow,
وَسَخَّرْتَ بِهِ السَّحَابَ
WA SAKHKHARTA BIHIS SAHAAB
made the clouds subservient,
وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ
WASH SHAMSA WAL QAMARA WAN NUJOOM
as well as the sun, the moon, the stars,
وَاللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ
WAL LAYLA WAN NAHAAR
the night, and the daylight,
وَخَلَقْتَ الْخَلائِقَ كُلَّهَا
WA KHALAQTAL KHALAA'IQA KULLAHAA
and created all beings.
اَسْاَلُكَ بِعَظَمَةِ وَجْهِكَ الْعَظِيمِ
AS'ALUKA BI-A'ZAMATI WAJHIKAL A'ZEEM
I implore You by the magnitude of Your Magnificent Face
الَّذِي اَشْرَقَتْ لَهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالَارْضُ
ALLADHEE ASHRAQAT LAHUS SAMAAWAATU WAL ARD
to which the heavens and the earth shone
فَاَضَاءَتْ بِهِ الظُّلُمَاتُ
FA-ADAA'AT BIHIZ ZULUMAAT
causing darkness to change into lights,
اِلَّا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
ILLAA SALLAYTA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD
(I implore You by all these) to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
وَكَفَيْتَنِي اَمْرَ مَعَاشِي وَمَعَادِي
WA KAFAYTANEE AMRA MA'AASHEE WA MA'AADEE
save me from the troubles of my living and my other life,
وَاَصْلَحْتَ لِي شَاْنِي كُلَّهُ
WA ASLAHTA LEE SHA'NEE KULLAH
amend all my affairs,
وَلَمْ تَكِلْنِي اِلَىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
WA LAM TAKILNEE ILAA NAFSEE TARFATA A'YN
not to cause me to depend upon myself for even a winking of an eye,
وَاَصْلَحْتَ اَمْرِي وَاَمْرَ عِيَالِي
WA ASLAHTA AMREE WA AMRA I'YAALEE
manage the affairs of my household and me,
وَكَفَيْتَنِي هَمَّهُمْ
WA KAFAYTANEE HAMMAHUM
save me from their concerns,
وَاَغْنَيْتَنِي وَاِيَّاهُمْ مِنْ كَنْزِكَ وَخَزَائِنِكَ
WA AGHNAYTANEE WA IYYAAHUM MIN KANZIKA WA KHAZAA'INIK
make them and me rich out of Your treasure, hoards,
وَسَعَةِ فَضْلِكَ الَّذِي لَا يَنْفَدُ اَبَداً
WA SA'ATI FADLIKAL LADHEE LAA YANFADU ABADAA
and Your expansive grace that never runs out,
وَاَثْبِتْ فِي قَلْبِي يَنَابِيعَ الْحِكْمَةِ
WA ATHBIT FEE QALBEE YANAABEE'AL HIKMAH
fix in my heart founts of sagacity
الَّتِي تَنْفَعُنِي بِهَا
ALLATEE TANFA'UNEE BIHAA
from which I may benefit
وَتَنْفَعُ بِهَا مَنِ ارْتَضَيْتَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
WA TANFA'U BIHAA MANIR TADAYTA MIN I'BAADIK
and from which You may benefit Your servants with whom You are pleased,
وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ
WAJ'AL LEE MINAL MUTTAQEEN
choose for me an imam (i.e. leader)
فِي آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ اِمَاماً
FEE AAKHIRIZ ZAMAANI IMAAMAA
that is pious in the last of time
كَمَا جَعَلْتَ اِبْرَاهِيمَ الْخَلِيلَ اِمَاماً
KAMAA JA'ALTA IBRAAHEEMAL KHALEELA IMAAMAA
in the same way as You made Abraham Your intimate friend to be a leader.

FA-INNA BITAWFEEQIKA YAFOOZUL FAA'IZOON
Verily, only through Your guidance do the winners achieve prosperity,
وَيَتُوبُ التَّائِبُونَ
WA YATOOBUT TAA'IBOON
the repentant declare repentance,
وَيَعْبُدُكَ الْعَابِدُونَ
WA YA'BUDUKAL A'ABIDOON
and the true worshippers worship You.
وَبِتَسْدِيدِكَ يَصْلُحُ الصَّالِحُونَ
WA BITASDEEDIKA YASLUHUS SAALIHOON
And only through Your supervision do the righteous,

the good-doers, those who humble themselves before You,
الْعَابِدُونَ لَكَ الْخَائِفُونَ مِنْكَ
AL-A'ABIDOONA LAKAL KHAA'IFOONA MINK
those who worship You sincerely, and those who fear You become righteous.
وَبِاِرْشَادِكَ نَجَا النَّاجُونَ مِنْ نَارِكَ
WA BI-IRSHAADIKA NAJAN NAAJOONA MIN NAARIK
And only through Your direction will those who will be delivered from Your Hellfire be saved
وَاَشْفَقَ مِنْهَا الْمُشْفِقُونَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ

and those who fear You, from amongst Your creatures, stand in awe of it.

But through Your disappointing them will the wrong lose,

the unjust perish,
وَغَفَلَ الْغَافِلُونَ
WA GHAFALAL GHAAFILOON
and those distracted from You be inattentive.
اَللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا
ALLAAHUMMA AATI NAFSEE TAQWAAHAA

FA-ANTA WALIYYUHAA WA MAWLAAHAA
for You are its guardian and master

and You are the best to purify it.

inspire it with what is good for it,

carry to it the good news of Your mercy when You grasp it,

lodge it in the highest positions of the gardens of Paradise,

make good its death and life,

and honor its place and abode

and its dwelling and house,

for You are its guardian and master.

YAA MAN AZHARAL JAMEEL
O He Who has shown only goodness

WA SATARAL QABEEH
and concealed the evil (deeds of His servants)!
يَا مَنْ لَمْ يُؤَاخِذْ بِٱلْجَرِيرَةِ
YAA MAN LAM YU'AAKHIDH BIL JAREERAH
O He Who has not censured for the offenses
وَلَمْ يَهْتِكِ ٱلسِّتْرَ
WA LAM YAHTIKIS SITR
and has not exposed the hidden!
يَا عَظِيمَ ٱلْعَفْوِ
YAA A'ZEEMAL A'FW
O He Who is Ample in pardoning!
يَا حَسَنَ ٱلتَّجَاوُزِ
YAA HASANAT TAJAAWUZ
O He Who is Excellent in overlooking!
يَا وَاسِعَ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
YAA WAASI'AL MAGHFIRAH
O He Who is Liberal in forgiving!
يَا بَاسِطَ ٱلْيَدَيْنِ بِٱلرَّحْمَةِ
YAA BAASITAL YADAYNI BIR RAHMAH
O He Who opens His hands wide with mercy!
يَا صَاحِبَ كُلِّ نَجْوَىٰ
YAA SAAHIBA KULLI NAJWAA
O He Who is present in all confidential talks!
يَا مُنْتَهَىٰ كُلِّ شَكْوَىٰ
YAA MUNTAHAA KULLI SHAKWAA
O He Who is the ultimate objective of all complaints!
يَا كَرِيـمَ ٱلصَّفْحِ
YAA KAREEMAS SAFH
O He Who is Generous in condonation!
يَا عَظِيمَ ٱلرَّجَاءِ
YAA A'ZEEMAR RAJAA'
O He Who is greatly hoped!
يَا مُبْتَدِئاً بِٱلنِّعَمِ قَبْلَ ٱسْتِحْقَاقِهَا
YAA MUBTADI'AN BIN NI'AMI QABLAS TIHQAAQIHAA
O He Who takes the initiative in favoring before they are deserved!
يَا رَبَّنَا وَسَيِّدَنَا وَمَوْلاَنَا
YAA RABBANAA WA SAYYIDANAA WA MAWLAANAA
O our Lord, our Master, and our Chief!
يَا غَايَةَ رَغْبَتِنَا
YAA GHAAYATA RAGHBATINAA
O He Who is the ultimate of our desires!
اَسْاَلُكَ ٱللَّهُمَّ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ

YAA HALEEMU DHOO ANAATIN
O Indulgent, Forbearing,

GHAFOORUN WADOOD

اَنْ تَتَجَاوَزَ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِي وَمَا عِنْدِي
AN TATAJAAWAZA A'N SAYYI'AATEE WA MAA I'NDEE
to overlook my sins and what I have had,
بِحُسْنِ مَا عِنْدَكَ

out of the excellence of what You have,

and to give me part of Your pardon

and I have never been given any good thing from any source except You.

YAA ABSARAL ABSAREEN

WA YAA ASMA'AS SAAMI'EEN
O He Who is the best Hearer of all those who can hear!

WA YAA AHKAMAL HAAKIMEEN
O He Who is the Justest of all those who judge!
وَيَا جَارَ ٱلْمُسْتَجِيرِينَ

SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD
